about: sha256 of each sample city's city_model.json (vesper_bay was nyxllor up to M8c, renamed with the same layout; citygen build output, M12 on M9 and M11: M12 (stack and turbine interchanges; no sample has two highways crossing with room for one, so every model is the M9 and M11 one byte for byte apart from spec_sha256, which hashes the filled spec and so its new defaults highways.crossings and highways.named[].reuse) on M9 tunnels (nexus_city: a cut-and-cover tunnel under Midtown, peninsula_city: an immersed tube; the metro lowered under foundations, pedestrian underpasses) and M11 (the gameplay layer: points of interest, zones, wealth, danger and police fields, street densities, parking, travel points and sign slots, district params gain wealth, danger and police) on M8c on M8d: M8b on M8a, the trumpet with one loop and one flyover (M8d, only vesper_bay has a trumpet), and transit that passes on a city's first layout: flying loops as Dubins rings, open lines off the roads or as Dubins paths where the roads fail them (M8c); archipelago_free_port is unchanged from M8b). The same bytes on every machine with the pinned requirements: produced for M12 on M9 and M11 (and before it M11 on M9, M9, M11 and M8c) on the M4 Mac and, byte for byte, on x86_64 Linux (docker, linux/amd64); earlier milestones confirmed with GEOS 3.14.1 rebuilt with clang against libc++ (the C++ library of macOS builds) and with one worker and another PYTHONHASHSEED; traces of every stage are in docs/progress/M1b_det/ (M1b), docs/progress/M2/<city>/trace.json (M2), docs/progress/M3/<city>/trace.json (M3) and docs/progress/M3p/<city>/trace.json (M3p) docs/progress/M5/<city>/trace.json (M5) docs/progress/M6/<city>/trace.json (M6), docs/progress/M7/<city>/trace.json (M7a) docs/progress/M7b/<city>/trace.json (M7b), docs/progress/M8a/<city>/trace.json (M8a) and docs/progress/M8b/<city>/trace.json (M8b on M8a), docs/progress/M8d/<city>/trace.json (M8d) and docs/progress/M8c/<city>/trace.json (M8c on M8d), docs/progress/M11/<city>/trace.json (M11) and docs/progress/M9/<city>/trace.json (M11 on M9), docs/progress/M12/<city>/trace.json (M12 on M9 and M11). blockout_plans change with M9 (tunnel geometry) and not with M11 (the layer adds no blockout geometry) nor with M12 (no sample has a stack). tests/test_roads.py asserts them on every run. blockout_plans: sha256 of each sample's blockout_plan.json (citygen blockout, M4), asserted by tests/test_blockout.py; the plan is the same bytes on every machine, Blender only draws it. terrain_cities (M13): sha256 of the hilly sample's city_model.json (cities/cragmouth), asserted by tests/test_terrain.py with its blockout plan under blockout_plans; the flat samples are byte-identical to M12 on M9 and M11 (M13 changes nothing on a city without terrain).

produced_on.machine: arm64 (M4 Mac), confirmed on x86_64 Linux (docker, linux/amd64)
produced_on.confirmed_on: M8b: x86_64 Linux container citygen-x86 (same sha256 for all five and the pinned demo); M8d: produced on x86_64 Linux (cloud container, Python 3.13.17), Mac identity to be confirmed; M11: produced on the M4 Mac and confirmed byte for byte on x86_64 Linux (container citygen-x86, CITYGEN_WORKERS=3), all five and the pinned demo, stage traces identical; M9 with M11: produced on the M4 Mac and, byte for byte, on x86_64 Linux (container citygen-x86, CITYGEN_WORKERS=3); M12 on M9 and M11: produced on the M4 Mac and confirmed byte for byte on x86_64 Linux (container citygen-x86, CITYGEN_WORKERS=3), all five, the pinned demo and the stack demo, stage traces identical; M13 on M12: all five, the pinned demo, the stack demo and cragmouth produced on the M4 Mac and confirmed byte for byte on x86_64 Linux (container citygen-x86, CITYGEN_WORKERS=3)
